source: GitHub Actions PR788 head5fbb, shard3; native browser events with sanitized URLs and no raw navigation keys
classification: Application cause observed in CI, distinct from the earlier standalone mechanism-only probe
cause: The same preview iframe element 5 switched from static srcdoc to the boot about:blank document and back to the identical 59-character static document. In both failed attempts those committed child navigations raised shared history length from 3 to 4 to 5 at top-level index1, before the move and cancellation. The successful attempt detached the old frame before the blank navigation committed and stayed at length3.
fix: Give static, runtime, device-runtime and boot iframe modes distinct constant React keys. Preserve iframe refs, source attributes, sandbox, callbacks and stable-mode identity.
componentRegression: Real Preview rendered with controlled nanostore files: static document → transiently empty files → static document. Before: restored frame was the boot DOM element. After: distinct elements; static sandbox unchanged; rerendering identical static files keeps the frame.
